p01.name: Hotel Indigo Chongqing Chaotianmen · Raffles City
p01.notes: 5 nights, Wed 9 to Mon 14 Dec · Booked direct with IHG · Diamond Elite · Confirmation 88413413. Floors 24F to 32F and 34F to 40F, No. 2 Jiesheng Street, Chongqing 400011. Newly opened property. Film arrival, room, benefits, river views and honest review.

p02.name: Guardian Han Tang (Han Tang House)
p02.notes: Mon 14 to Fri 18 Dec. Address on booking: 32 Nanchang Ln, Xincheng, Xi'an 710002 (Wanderlog also lists No. 1 Zikou, Nanqiao, Lianhu District; confirm which entrance). Han/Tang-inspired boutique stay with restaurant, bar and bike rentals. Add room category.

p03.name: Chengdu Yunzhongyue Apartment (Taikoo Li)
p03.notes: Home base for the whole trip, Sun 6 to Tue 29 Dec (kept during Chongqing and Xi'an). Room 410, Building 6, 1 Dong Xin Jie, Jinjiang District, Chengdu 610017. Confirmations 1688898480013000 and 1688898480011084. Apartment stay: register at the local police station within 24 hours of arrival. Film a real-life apartment review and the Taikoo Li neighbourhood.

p04.name: InterContinental Chengdu Global Center
p04.notes: Christmas Eve to Christmas Day, Thu 24 to Fri 25 Dec · Booked direct with IHG · Diamond Elite + Ambassador · Confirmation 85746263. 1736 Tianfu Avenue North, Global Center, Chengdu 610041. Confirm water park renovation status before travel.

p05.name: Terracotta Warriors / Emperor Qinshihuang's Mausoleum Site Museum
p05.notes: A must-film visit. Add your chosen date, ticket/time slot and guided-tour details when confirmed.

p06.name: Tang Dynasty-themed evening performance
p06.notes: Show idea only. Choose venue, check current programme, dates and permission to record.

p07.name: Chongqing river skyline & night views
p07.notes: Evening city B-roll; Hongya Cave from across the water, monorail through the building. Saturday drone show if the dates line up, check the schedule on arrival.

p08.name: Chongqing hot pot experience
p08.notes: Film menu, ordering, preparation, final bill and a genuine reaction. Shoot it so it can be compared with Chengdu hotpot later.

p09.name: Xi'an City Wall
p09.notes: Optional experience; check entry arrangements before booking. Golden hour, bikes on the wall.

p10.name: Sichuan opera / face-changing show
p10.notes: Choose a specific performance and confirm whether video recording is allowed.

p11.name: Chengdu panda experience
p11.notes: Optional filming and sightseeing idea; choose the specific destination. Early morning slot if you go.

p12.name: Explore the Global Center complex
p12.notes: Shopping, architecture and accessible facilities. Water park currently has a renovation notice, recheck before travelling.

p13.name: Flights out: Cork to London to Chengdu
p13.notes: Sat 5 Dec: Aer Lingus EI 718 ORK 16:05 to LHR 17:20, then Air China CA 424 LHR 21:30 to Chengdu TFU 16:10 next day. Confirmation 2KQT6F. Film: airport, the transfer at Heathrow, landing in Chengdu, first steps (activate the eSIM before landing).

p14.name: Flights home: Chengdu to London to Cork
p14.notes: Tue 29 Dec: Air China CA 423 TFU 15:30 to LHR 19:20, then Aer Lingus EI 725 LHR 22:05 to ORK 23:25. Confirmation 2KQT6F. Check out of the apartment the same morning.

p15.name: Chuanyue Old Hot Pot (WWII bunker hotpot)
p15.notes: Hotpot inside a World War II air-raid bunker. From TikTok: Chongqing Underground Hot Pot. Strong hook for a Reel: 'We ate hotpot in a bomb shelter'.

p16.name: Luohan Temple
p16.notes: Restored Buddhist temple hidden between skyscrapers, stone and clay sculptures. Quiet morning ambient clip, contrast shot with the towers behind.

p17.name: Nanshan cliffside hotpot (Xian Longjing, Jiabin shop)
p17.notes: Buffet hotpot on the Nanshan cliff with the city lights below. From TikTok: Cliffside Dinner Spots Chongqing. Go at dusk for the light change. Nearby: Small Forest (Xiaoshulin Live) for drinks after.

p18.name: Small Forest (Xiaoshulin Live), Nanshan
p18.notes: Live music venue on the Nanshan cliff. From TikTok: Cliffside Dinner Spots Chongqing. Pair with the cliffside hotpot evening.

p19.name: Hongya Cave (Hongyadong)
p19.notes: Must-see; the stacked riverside building lit at night. Walking distance from Hotel Indigo Chaotianmen. Film from across the river (Qiansimen bridge) and inside the floors. Expect crowds after dark.

p20.name: Liziba station (monorail through the building)
p20.notes: Line 2 train passing through a residential building. Wanderlog flags the station entry as permanently closed; the viewing platform below is the filming spot, check on the day. Ride Line 2 along the river too, great B-roll.

p21.name: Wulong karst (Transformers filming location)
p21.notes: Full day trip from the city (about 2.5 hours each way). Three Natural Bridges, Transformers 4 location. Only if a day frees up; it is nature, not city.

p22.name: Yangtze River Cableway
p22.notes: Cable car across the Yangtze. Book ahead, long queues. Best at dusk for the skyline. Film inside the cabin and the queue reality.

p23.name: Dazu Rock Carvings (Art Museum)
p23.notes: UNESCO site, cliff carvings, about 2 hours from the city. Day trip option, culture angle.

p24.name: Shangshanzhu drone show river view suite
p24.notes: Vacation rental with a river view of the drone show. Saved from TikTok (Chongqing Cyberpunk City Guide). Hotel Indigo is already booked; keep as a drone-show viewpoint reference. Saturday 12 Dec is the drone show night during the stay.

p25.name: Great Mosque of Xi'an
p25.notes: Built in 742, Chinese-style mosque with gardens, inside the Muslim Quarter. Combine with the food street walk.

p26.name: Bell Tower and Drum Tower (鼓楼)
p26.notes: Ming dynasty towers in the city centre, lit at night. Book ahead. Drum Tower is the gateway to the Muslim Quarter.

p27.name: Muslim Quarter food streets (Huimin Jie)
p27.notes: Roujiamo, biangbiang noodles, persimmon cakes, lamb skewers. Film a street food montage of 5 to 8 short clips with prices on screen.
